sheet_from: Data/World12/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under a bc_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool and every name is another world's too. World12 is all seven castles' data (MapManager.cpp:1104-1107, 1207-1210). Its other sheets (TileGround01 is absent; TileRock01/03/04, TileWater01, TileWood01) are in the folder but no tile wears them, so they are not decoded. docs/blood-castle-port.md.
slot_note: MU sows no grass in a castle (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:2082), though World12 ships a TileGrass01.OZT; terrain.py GRASS_BY_MAP[11] is empty. The castle is a strip down the grid's west edge, x 0-30: the safe court at 8-19,3-14, the long walk south over a NoGround chasm, the drawbridge at 13-15,70-75 before the door at 14,75, and the courtyard beyond.
material_note: Read off the art; the names lie. TileGrass01 is blue-grey brick, 97% of the map, laid stone: flagstone, never grass. TileGrass02 is green-grey mossy rock and TileGround02 dark rough earth: rock. TileGround03 is the courtyard's octagon paving, grey slabs with olive insets: flagstone. TileRock02 is dark planks banded in iron, eighteen tiles at 13-15,70-75, the drawbridge before the castle door: plank.
